title: indigo_agent_auxiliary, indigo_agent_scheduler: add the AGENT_AUX_SAFETY light and the scheduler unsafe hold with UNSAFE and SAFE hooks
description:
Requested by the owner on 2026-11-21 as the first part of weather and safety handling.

Define in the Auxiliary Agent (indigo_drivers/agent_auxiliary) one read-only light property AGENT_AUX_SAFETY with the single item SAFE, in the shape already used by X_ALPACA_SAFETY (system_alpaca) and X_CONDITIONS_SAFETY (dome_beaver):
- IDLE: no safety information,
- OK: conditions are safe,
- ALERT: conditions are unsafe.
Publish the property and item names in indigo_drivers/agent_auxiliary/indigo_agent_auxiliary.h so that other agents (the Scheduler Agent) can use them. In this ticket the property is only defined and stays IDLE; the agent does not compute it yet.

Out of scope, to be implemented later on the owner's decision: the safety decision itself (which AUX device properties such as AUX_RAIN, AUX_WIND, AUX_CLOUD, X_ALPACA_SAFETY or X_CONDITIONS_SAFETY count, in their switch or light encodings, and which of their values are unsafe) and a configurable treatment of a lost safety source (safe or unsafe).

Acceptance: the property is defined on attach with state IDLE and item SAFE IDLE, is enumerated and deleted with the agent, is documented in indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md (Auxiliary agent section), DRIVER_VERSION of the agent is bumped, and a test checks that the property is defined with the documented shape. Do not change the agent README.md without owner approval.

outcome.summary: No defects found. Agent: AGENT_AUX_SAFETY (light, RO, AGENT_MAIN_GROUP, item SAFE, property+item IDLE) created after successful indigo_filter_device_attach, defined through agent_enumerate_properties that matches the agent_mount pattern (own-filter-client guard, INDIGO_DEFINE_MATCHING_PROPERTY, delegate to indigo_filter_enumerate_properties); released in detach before indigo_filter_device_detach; private data allocated at INIT and freed after detach at SHUTDOWN, same as agent_mount; additional instances get their own zeroed private data via update_additional_instances and their own property. The guard only skips the agent's own filter client, whose define callback ignores its own device anyway, so filter behaviour is unchanged (test_aux_simulator 13/13 incl. auxiliary_agent_mirrors_all_devices). DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000005->0x03000006, names in the header, PROPERTIES.md row correct, Makefile target + INTEGRATION_TESTS entry and Xcode file ref + integration group membership correct; git diff --check clean. Test checks type/perm/state/group/count/item name/value on attach, name-selected (count 1) and full enumeration, one delete on shutdown and identical shape after re-init; deterministic (3/3 runs pass). generate_help.py --check reports the bundle current; decoding old/new header shows only mcp_help_text_11 (auxiliary.md) changed, metadata identical. Tests: test-agent-auxiliary 3/3 x3 runs, test_aux_simulator 13/13; test-clean run afterwards.

Integration is clean: scheduler-local names AUX_AGENT/AUX_SAFETY_PROPERTY/AUX_SAFETY_SAFE_ITEM (indigo_agent_scheduler.c:61-63) equal indigo_agent_auxiliary.h:50-51; test_agent_scheduler.c includes that header (line 45) so the #ifndef fallbacks (47-53) are inactive and identical; PROPERTIES.md Auxiliary row/source list and Scheduler section coexist without lost hunks; merge-tree vs master clean (master only adds factory close f626a7cf6); generate_help.py --check current; no conflict markers; pbxproj only adds test_agent_auxiliary.c. Code: Idle light counts as missing (evaluate_safety, indigo_agent_scheduler.c:2057-2060), so default SAFE keeps existing setups unchanged and UNSAFE holds indefinitely. DEFECT (docs, user-misleading): the scheduler docs never say that the current Auxiliary Agent defines AGENT_AUX_SAFETY but does not compute it and it always stays Idle. INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md:620 says 'Set up the safety in the Auxiliary Agent; the scheduler only reads it' although nothing can be set up there yet, and :636 says UNSAFE 'holds the scheduler until a safe signal arrives' which with the current agent never happens; SCHEDULER.md:605 (Unsafe hold, Safety) likewise. Fix: in both docs add one sentence that the Auxiliary Agent does not compute the light yet, so it stays Idle, AGENT_SCHEDULER_SAFETY_MISSING decides, and UNSAFE then holds the scheduler permanently (keep SAFE until the agent computes safety); drop or reword 'Set up the safety in the Auxiliary Agent'. Optional nit: the comment 'until its header provides them' at test_agent_scheduler.c:47 is stale; the fallback block can be removed.

Re-review of tree b79804a58f33 (commit 62a33fcfd). The fix is docs only (+5 -3) in indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md and indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md; nothing else changed since 23e814c31 and the worktree is clean. GUIDE:620 now ends 'The scheduler only reads the light.' (the misleading 'Set up the safety in the Auxiliary Agent' is gone); a new note at :622 says the current Auxiliary Agent defines AGENT_AUX_SAFETY but does not compute it, the light stays Idle, SAFETY_MISSING decides, keep SAFE; :638 adds that UNSAFE then holds permanently. SCHEDULER.md:605 Safety paragraph states the same. This matches the code (Idle counts as missing, evaluate_safety indigo_agent_scheduler.c:2057-2060) and the AUX docs (PROPERTIES.md row, mcp/agents/auxiliary.md). generate_help.py --check is current (the scheduler docs are not in the bundle). Earlier integration findings still hold. Optional nit not fixed: the stale fallback comment at test_agent_scheduler.c:47.
